datasets.name: ds_stream
queryLines:
SELECT stream_id, table_name,
  COALESCE(protocol, 'Unknown') AS protocol,
  COALESCE(data_format, 'Unknown') AS data_format,
  opened_time, closed_time, event_time,
  event_time AS commit_time,
  SIZE(errors) AS error_count,
  CASE WHEN opened_time IS NOT NULL THEN stream_id END AS opened_sid,
  CASE WHEN closed_time IS NOT NULL THEN stream_id END AS closed_sid
FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_stream

datasets.name: ds_ingest
queryLines:
SELECT stream_id, table_name, commit_version, commit_time,
  committed_bytes, committed_records,
  SIZE(errors) AS error_count
FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest

datasets.name: ds_leaderboard
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT table_name,
    SUM(committed_records) AS total_records,
    SUM(committed_bytes) AS total_bytes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stream_id) AS unique_streams,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SIZE(errors) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_commits
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest GROUP BY table_name
)
SELECT a.table_name, COALESCE(_ow.table_owner, 'Unknown') AS owner,
  a.total_records, a.total_bytes, a.unique_streams, a.error_commits
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.tables _ow
  ON SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[0] = _ow.table_catalog
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[1] = _ow.table_schema
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[2] = _ow.table_name
ORDER BY a.total_bytes DESC

datasets.name: ds_recent_errors
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'ingest' AS source, stream_id, table_name,
    commit_time, SIZE(errors) AS error_count
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest
  WHERE SIZE(errors) > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'stream' AS source, stream_id, table_name,
    event_time AS commit_time, SIZE(errors) AS error_count
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_stream
  WHERE SIZE(errors) > 0 AND table_name IS NOT NULL
) ORDER BY commit_time DESC LIMIT 100

datasets.name: ds_top10
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT table_name,
    SUM(committed_records) AS total_records,
    SUM(committed_bytes) AS total_bytes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stream_id) AS unique_streams
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest GROUP BY table_name
  ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT a.table_name, COALESCE(_ow.table_owner, 'Unknown') AS owner,
  a.total_records, a.total_bytes, a.unique_streams
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.tables _ow
  ON SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[0] = _ow.table_catalog
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[1] = _ow.table_schema
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[2] = _ow.table_name

datasets.name: ds_stream_rates
queryLines:
SELECT stream_id, table_name,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', commit_time) AS commit_time,
  ROUND(SUM(committed_bytes) / 3600.0) AS bytes_per_sec,
  ROUND(SUM(committed_records) / 3600.0) AS records_per_sec,
  ROUND(SUM(committed_bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(committed_records), 0)) AS avg_record_bytes
FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest
GROUP BY stream_id, table_name, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', commit_time)

datasets.name: ds_table_rates
queryLines:
SELECT table_name,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', commit_time) AS commit_time,
  ROUND(SUM(committed_bytes) / 3600.0) AS bytes_per_sec
FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest
GROUP BY table_name, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', commit_time)

datasets.name: ds_stream_lifecycle
queryLines:
SELECT op.stream_id, op.table_name, op.opened_time, cl.closed_time,
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(cl.closed_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(op.opened_time) AS duration_sec,
  CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(cl.closed_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(op.opened_time) >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS over_900s,
  op.opened_time AS commit_time
FROM (
  SELECT stream_id, table_name, MIN(opened_time) AS opened_time
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_stream WHERE opened_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stream_id, table_name
) op
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT stream_id, MIN(closed_time) AS closed_time
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_stream WHERE closed_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stream_id
) cl ON op.stream_id = cl.stream_id

datasets.name: ds_concurrent
queryLines:
SELECT table_name,
  DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', event_time) AS commit_time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT stream_id) AS concurrent_streams
FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_stream
WHERE opened_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY table_name, DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', event_time)

datasets.name: ds_owner_agg
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT table_name,
    SUM(committed_bytes) AS total_bytes,
    SUM(committed_records) AS total_records,
    COUNT(*) AS commits
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest GROUP BY table_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(_ow.table_owner, 'Unknown') AS owner,
  SUM(a.total_bytes) AS total_bytes,
  SUM(a.total_records) AS total_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.table_name) AS table_count
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.tables _ow
  ON SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[0] = _ow.table_catalog
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[1] = _ow.table_schema
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[2] = _ow.table_name
GROUP BY _ow.table_owner ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_stale
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT table_name,
    MAX(commit_time) AS last_commit,
    ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(commit_time))) / 3600, 1) AS hours_since_last,
    SUM(committed_records) AS total_records
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest GROUP BY table_name
  ORDER BY last_commit ASC LIMIT 25
)
SELECT a.table_name, COALESCE(_ow.table_owner, 'Unknown') AS owner,
  a.last_commit, a.hours_since_last, a.total_records
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.tables _ow
  ON SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[0] = _ow.table_catalog
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[1] = _ow.table_schema
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[2] = _ow.table_name

datasets.name: ds_error_by_table
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT table_name,
    SUM(SIZE(errors)) AS total_errors,
    MAX(commit_time) AS last_error
  FROM system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest
  WHERE SIZE(errors) > 0 GROUP BY table_name
)
SELECT a.table_name, COALESCE(_ow.table_owner, 'Unknown') AS owner,
  a.total_errors, a.last_error
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.tables _ow
  ON SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[0] = _ow.table_catalog
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[1] = _ow.table_schema
  AND SPLIT(a.table_name, '[.]')[2] = _ow.table_name
ORDER BY a.total_errors DESC

datasets.name: ds_billing
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date AS commit_time, sku_name,
  SUM(usage_quantity) AS dbus
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE billing_origin_product = 'LAKEFLOW_CONNECT'
GROUP BY usage_date, sku_name

datasets.name: ds_billing_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date) AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 0) AS total_dbus,
  sku_name
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE billing_origin_product = 'LAKEFLOW_CONNECT'
GROUP BY 1, sku_name ORDER BY 1 DESC

**HTTP Limits** — 10K req/s, 10K max cached streams, 60s cache TTL, 30s idle eviction

**SDK Defaults** — max 50K in-flight records, 5 min flush timeout, 60s server ack timeout, 3 recovery retries
